meta.name: Start Work Confirmation
meta.description: After a break ends, show a dialog and wait for the user to press Start before the next work interval begins. Skips the dialog if the break was interrupted by a suspend (the machine slept), so waking up after a sleep just continues work. Also: if the user is away from the PC (no keyboard/mouse input and no browser video playing) for idle_gate_seconds, pause the remaining work time and show the same Start dialog until it is pressed. REQUIRES the smartpause plugin to be disabled.

settings.label: Dialog message
settings.default: Break is over. Press Start to begin your next work session.

settings.label: Pause + show Start dialog when away from PC
